newsitem.title: Japan: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 4.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.

-- Finance Ministry plans to lift ban on securities companies offering multi-service accounts from April 1. The move will allow customers to automatically transfer money from stocks sales to money management funds (MMFs) and medium-term government fund accounts.
--- Sony Corp plans to buy about 60 percent of the shares in Tokyu Agency International (TAI) in order to start advertising business as early as April.
--- News Corp and Softbank, Japan's biggest software distributor, have decided to sell their shares in Asahi National Broadcasting Co (TV Asahi).
--- The Liberal Democratic Party will submit a bill to allow the use of maiden names on legal documents.
